scenarios.name: confluence-and-heritage
scenarios.note: Knowledge refilled to the cap every round: the diversifying scholar researches five different domains in a row, then Heritage and OU choices.

scenarios.name: overextension-and-devastation
scenarios.note: Administrative base 1 from round 4 and extra Pioneiros so the builder keeps founding cities, and a city is emptied of habitants by mobilizing it below its built level.

scenarios.name: n7-era-vii
scenarios.note: Round 30: the capital is a Metrópole with 18 habitants, Saneamento and Metrópoles do Mundo researched, resources full. Elevar to N7 is Era VII only.

scenarios.name: hegemony-territorial
scenarios.note: Test configuration: the territorial path asks for 2 hexes and administrative capacity in the match rules, so the Era VII declaration and the two-round hold run through the real command.

scenarios.name: siege-war
scenarios.note: Round 7: war is declared, the enemy capital has a stone wall, and the warrior's army (4 Infantaria, 2 Cerco) stands next to it, outside its own supply.

scenarios.name: conquest
scenarios.note: Round 6: war, the enemy capital stands without garrison or walls, and the warrior's six Infantaria are next to it: a city taken by an unopposed assault (Δ > 0, no defender left).

scenarios.name: pirates-and-bands
scenarios.note: Round 3: a pirate threat is summoned through the event command, and a camp is reinforced; the Era turn activates them.
